Criterion: Verify that necessary deployment power is available under normal and emergency conditions and that there is no interference with manual actuation of the canopy when air vehicle or external power is not available. Standard: An alternate or secondary power source is provided that will operate the canopy. A manual system is provided for ingress and egress with all aircraft power off and for canopy operation when primary actuation system is not available. An external means is provided to enable a ground rescue crew to manually open the canopy. Method of Compliance: Deployment power availability and manual capabilities are verified through system demonstrations, subsystem testing, and vehicle functional tests. References: JSSG-2010-14 14 CFR 23.775, 25.775, 27.775, 29.775

Standard: Deployment power is available under normal and emergency conditions and there is no interference with manual actuation of the canopy when air vehicle or external power is not available. An alternate or secondary power source is provided that will operate the canopy. A manual system is provided for ingress and egress with all air vehicle power off and for canopy operation when primary actuation system is not available. An external means is provided to enable a ground rescue crew to manually open the canopy. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Demonstration.
(1) Conduct demonstration on the air vehicle to verify deployment power availability and manual capabilities. Test.
  (1) Lab test: Conduct lab testing to verify deployment power availability of the actuation system.
